content: PWA scaffold built in /mnt/user-data/outputs/green-room/ containing: index.html (Green Room app with PWA head tags and an install-hint glue script appended), manifest.webmanifest (standalone display, brand colors #0a130d, full icon set), sw.js (cache-first app-shell service worker, version 'green-room-v1'), icon.svg (jade/gold/teal brand glyph evoking the breathing orb), and PNG icons at 192/512/180/512-maskable/48. All icons rendered from the SVG via sharp. Both inline script blocks verified parseable; manifest valid JSON; sw.js syntax clean; local server returned 200 for every asset. The install-hint glue is conservative: it suppresses on standalone, listens for Android beforeinstallprompt to show an Install button, and falls back to a one-time iOS Safari hint (Share -> Add to Home Screen). One bug caught during build: a quoted 'Segoe UI' in a JS string literal broke the parser; fixed by dropping the quoted family from the font stack. Honest framing given to Anthony: the link works on every phone instantly with zero friction, but the 'app icon' step is a manual one-time tap by the friend; not auto-prompted on iOS, do not oversell. Three host options laid out in README.txt: Netlify Drop for tonight (no account, ~60s), Cloudflare Pages on a thetempleoftwo.com subdomain for the durable version (he has Cloudflare connected and owns the domain), or GitHub Pages. The App Store route was explicitly de-recommended for the current scope. Retrieve when Anthony asks about Green Room deployment, hosting, PWA installability, or making the app shareable.
